Frustrating Signup Experience
This is one of the most frustrating signup experiences I’ve had. Requiring both email and a verified mobile number just to order feels unnecessarily complicated. Even after signing up with my email, I’m still blocked because my number isn’t verified, so I can’t place my order. A simple email should be enough to create an account, as some services allow, so people can start shopping without extra hurdles. For example, some platforms prioritize a quick email-based signup to keep the process easy. The current friction can stop genuine customers from placing orders, which is frustrating and a missed opportunity. Please simplify the signup flow so customers can get started with just an email.

Wrong Products, Denied Returns, Poor Support
I had a very disappointing experience with Myntra customer support. They were unable to properly investigate or resolve my issue. I have faced problems with two different orders from the seller Livewear, where the wrong products were delivered. Despite this, my return requests were denied without a proper investigation.

Because of this, Myntra is making me bear a loss of nearly ₹6,000 for products that were not what I ordered. As a customer, I expected Myntra to trace the issue, verify the deliveries, and provide a fair resolution instead of simply rejecting the returns. Myntra should improve its customer support and ensure sellers are held accountable when they ship incorrect products.
